scripts.build: npm run rules && npm run build -w @profjero/shared && npm run build -w @profjero/functions && npm run build -w @profjero/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @profjero/shared && npm run test -w @profjero/web
scripts.test:emulator: npm run rules && npm run build -w @profjero/functions && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth,functions,storage --project demo-profjero "npm run test:emulator -w @profjero/functions"
